mapper.sql: p.id, p.space_no, p.area_name, p.space_type, p.space_size, p.month_fee, p.status, p.owner_id, p.car_plate, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.location, p.remark, p.create_time
, o.name AS owner_name, o.phone AS owner_phone
FROM parking_space p LEFT JOIN owner o ON o.id = p.owner_id

where.if: AND (p.space_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR p.car_plate LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR o.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR p.area_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO parking_space (space_no, area_name, space_type, space_size, month_fee, status, owner_id, car_plate, start_date, end_date, location, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{spaceNo}, #{areaName}, IFNULL(#{spaceType}, 'UNDERGROUND'), IFNULL(#{spaceSize}, '标准'), IFNULL(#{monthFee}, 0), IFNULL(#{status}, 'FREE'), #{ownerId}, #{carPlate}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{location}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE parking_space SET status = 'FREE', owner_id = NULL, car_plate = NULL, start_date = NULL, end_date = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT space_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FREE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS freeCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'FREE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS usedCount, SUM(IFNULL(month_fee, 0)) AS totalFee FROM parking_space GROUP BY space_type
